# Plugin skills

The 4 skills in the `gtme` plugin for Claude Code, from each `plugin/skills/*/SKILL.md`. Claude Code fires a skill on its own when a request matches its description, and you can call it by its slash command.

| Command | Skill | Fires when |
|---|---|---|
| `/gtme:analyze` | [`analyze`](https://github.com/gtme-run/gtme/blob/main/plugin/skills/analyze/SKILL.md) | Use when someone asks what gtme did, what it cost, what the cache saved, why a record was dropped or not contacted, what is known about a person or company and where each fact came from, who is in a group, or wants a number from past runs. |
| `/gtme:create-adapter` | [`create-adapter`](https://github.com/gtme-run/gtme/blob/main/plugin/skills/create-adapter/SKILL.md) | Use when a pipeline needs a vendor, API, or data source gtme does not ship — "gtme doesn't have X", "add Hunter/Clearbit/our CRM", a custom endpoint — or when the records are not people or companies (posts, jobs, events, repos) and need a new entity type. |
| `/gtme:create-pipeline` | [`create-pipeline`](https://github.com/gtme-run/gtme/blob/main/plugin/skills/create-pipeline/SKILL.md) | Use when someone describes an outreach or go-to-market goal in their own words and wants it built with gtme — a list to work, people to find or qualify, notes to write, a campaign or CRM to fill — before any pipeline file exists. |
| `/gtme:run-pipeline` | [`run-pipeline`](https://github.com/gtme-run/gtme/blob/main/plugin/skills/run-pipeline/SKILL.md) | Use when a gtme pipeline file or bundle exists and someone wants it run, tested, rehearsed, sent, or "just shipped" — including "run it", "send it", "get the leads into the campaign", "does this work", or a re-run after an edit. |
